description: This file defines an internal partial class 'ConfirmationWorker' in the 'Orleans.Transactions.State' namespace. It manages transaction confirmation and collection processes, including sending confirmations to participants, retrying on failures, and cleaning up transaction logs within an Orleans distributed transaction system.

classes.name: ConfirmationWorker<TState>
classes.description: Manages confirmation and cleanup of transactions, handling communication with participants and retry logic.

classes.name: Confirmation
classes.description: A nested struct tracking the confirmation status of a participant's transaction confirmation attempt.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a transaction ID to pending confirmations and initiates confirmation process.

methods.name: IsConfirmed
methods.description: Checks if a transaction ID has been confirmed.

methods.name: SendConfirmation
methods.description: Sends confirmation to all participants and then collects responses.

methods.name: NotifyAll
methods.description: Notifies all participants of a transaction and retries if needed.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Retries attempting to collect (clean up) a transaction until successful.

methods.name: TryCollect
methods.description: Attempts to remove a transaction record from the storage, returning success status.

methods.name: Confirmed
methods.description: Asynchronously confirms if a participant's confirmation has succeeded.

methods.name: LogTraceCollectionCompleted
methods.description: Logs that collection (cleanup) of a transaction has been completed.

methods.name: LogWarnCollectingTransaction
methods.description: Logs a warning when transaction cleanup fails and will be retried.

methods.name: LogWarningConfirmationFailed
methods.description: Logs a warning if a confirmation attempt fails, indicating a retry.
